P5768.corridor_notes: This PID is the '(Pidu Section)' of the wider 'Xinchang-Sanyi-Tianfu New District' gas pipeline (part of the Sichuan & Chongqing Grand Loop Line / 川渝大环线). Per prior ResearcherNotes, the overall project has Phase I (Xinchang-Sanyi) and Phase II (Sanyi-Tianfu New District), with the Pidu section belonging to Phase II. A Sichuan provincial procurement notice (ggzyjy.sc.gov.cn, 2025-12) for periodic long-distance-pipeline inspection names the full system '新场-三邑-郫县（含联通线、三三线）输气管道' (Xinchang-Sanyi-Pixian Gas Pipeline, incl. Liantong Line + Sansan Line) with stations 新场首站 (Xinchang First Station), 三邑调控中心 (Sanyi Control Center), 郫县分输站 (Pixian/Pidu Distribution Station), and trunk segments: Xinchang-Sanyi 42.6km (DN700), Sanyi-Pixian 49.68km (DN800), plus a 4.3km Liantong (connector) line and a 7.1km Sansan line -- total ~103.68km, crossing Chengdu and Deyang municipalities with a spur through Pengzhou. GEM's LengthMergedKm for this PID (21.00km) does not match the full 49.68km Sanyi-Pixian trunk length in the source, suggesting GEM's 'Pidu Section' captures only the portion of that trunk lying within Pidu District itself (the source separately notes a Pixian-Distribution-Station-to-boundary segment length ~7.8km in a related citation), or a different sub-division of the network than the one this procurement doc describes. Could not independently confirm Sanyi Distribution Station's exact town/county (candidate hits for a '三邑' place name in OSM -- a '三邑桥' bridge in Xindu District and a '三邑大桥' bridge in Pengzhou's Juntun town -- are inconclusive name matches, not confirmed station locations, so no coordinate was assigned for the start point per the no-invention rule).
P5768.researcher_notes: GEM's stated LengthMergedKm (21.00km) is shorter than the sourced Sanyi-Pixian trunk length (49.68km), consistent with the 'Pidu Section' being a sub-segment rather than the full Sanyi-Pixian run -- flagging for confirmation rather than treating as a discrepancy to fix. GEM's EndLocation 'Pi County' is corroborated by the source's 郫县分输站 terminus.
P5768.blockers: No verified source pins Sanyi Distribution Station to a specific town/county, so the start point has no coordinate (name only). A source combining the phrase '新场-三邑-天府新区（郫都段）' verbatim was not found; the corroborating source instead documents the closely related '新场-三邑-郫县' inspection-service system, which is treated as the same physical trunk based on shared station names (三邑, 郫县/郫都) and segment structure.

P7676.corridor_notes: This PID is the first phase (Jintang-Tong'an section) of the wider Jintang-Pingqiao Gas Pipeline (金堂—平桥输气管道工程, total 59.85km), which transports tight/dense gas from the Tianfu Gas Field's Jianyang block toward Chengdu. Per Sichuan Economic Daily (scjjrb.cn, 2026-05-18) and a matching Sina Finance report (2026-05-15), the Jintang-Tong'an section was formally commissioned on 2026-05-12, following nitrogen displacement and pressure-up; it includes three valve stations along the route (五通/Wutong, 丽阳/Liyang, 锦绣/Jinxiu) and terminates at the newly built Tong'an gas transmission station (同安输气站). A separate downstream section, Tong'an-to-Chengdu, was commissioned earlier (2026-03-15 per sc.sina.cn) feeding into the Chengdu Transmission Station (design pressure 4.0MPa, 4 billion m3/yr capacity) -- confirming 'Tong'an' here is a distinct waypoint/station short of Chengdu proper, not the pipeline's final destination. Tong'an itself resolves to Tong'an Subdistrict (同安街道) in Longquanyi District, Chengdu -- NOT a place in Jintang County itself, despite the segment being named 'Jintang-Tong'an'.
P7676.researcher_notes: GEM's StartLocation 'Jintang' and EndLocation 'Tong'an' are both corroborated, but the specific Jintang-side originating station name (e.g. a 'Jintang first station') was not found in the sources reviewed -- start point is geocoded at county level only. Note the corridor runs Jianyang block (gas source, not part of this PID) -> Jintang -> Tong'an (Longquanyi District, Chengdu) -> Chengdu Station (separate downstream PID/section, per the Tong'an-Pingqiao note already in ResearcherNotes).
P7676.blockers: No source names a specific Jintang-side station (only the county-level place 'Jintang' is confirmed), so the start coordinate is a county centroid rather than a station-level point.

P7685.corridor_notes: GEM's own zh_segment field ('D219管道彭州升平站—都江堰蒲阳站输气管道') and StartLocation/EndLocation (Shengping/Puyang) point to a specific, real pipeline: multiple independent search hits (a Dujiangyan municipal government safety-inspection notice at djy.gov.cn dated 2022-04-08, and matching bidcenter.com.cn tender/award notices from the same month) describe a 'D219 pipeline, Pengzhou Shengping Station to Dujiangyan Puyang Station gas transmission pipeline' (D219管道彭州升平站—都江堰蒲阳站输气管道) that is exactly 36 kilometers long -- matching GEM's LengthMergedKm precisely. However, every mirror of that notice (djy.gov.cn directly, and two bidcenter.com.cn copies) returned a bot-wall (HTTP 412 on djy.gov.cn via both WebFetch and url_verifier.py; a human-verification redirect on bidcenter.com.cn) and could not be independently read or verified live. A separate, independently-verified source (entrepreneurdaily.cn, 2023-10-25, url_verifier PASS) corroborates the general corridor -- a CNPC/Pengzhou gas transmission station renovation in Oct 2023 explicitly serving both Pengzhou and Dujiangyan residential/industrial users -- but does not itself name Shengping or Puyang stations, so it is not cited as a start/end ref.
P7685.researcher_notes: End point (Puyang) upgraded to ENDPOINTS-quality: jngas.cn (Dujiangyan Jinen Gas Co.) independently confirms a Puyang distribution station at a specific street address (都江堰市上阳街393号), geocoded to street level and cited with a verified ref. Start point (Shengping) remains unresolved to a station-specific address -- high confidence in the underlying pipeline's identity and length (36km exactly matches GEM's LengthMergedKm) from the djy.gov.cn/bidcenter.com.cn notices, but those are bot-walled (HTTP 412 / human-verification) and could not be independently fetched or verified, so the Shengping side is left as a road-name-level approximation with no ref. This is a liveness/bot-wall problem (HTTP 412), not a content problem -- a future pass reaching djy.gov.cn or bidcenter.com.cn (different network path, or once rate limits/JS challenges clear) would upgrade this PID fully to ENDPOINTS. Archive.org lookups were attempted but the wayback availability API was rate-limiting (HTTP 429) throughout this session. Overall resolution stays PARTIAL because the start point still lacks both a verified ref and a station-level coordinate.
P7685.blockers: Start point (Shengping) only: all three source mirrors found (djy.gov.cn, 2x bidcenter.com.cn) are bot-walled (412 / human-verification challenge) and could not be fetched by WebFetch, curl, or url_verifier.py; archive.org snapshot lookups were rate-limited (429) throughout the session. The Shengping coordinate given is a place-name-level approximation (a road named Shengping in Pengzhou), not a confirmed station address, and has no ref. The end point (Puyang) is resolved with a verified ref and street-level coordinate -- no blocker there.

P7687.corridor_notes: Per a Sichuan tender-notice aggregator (zhiliaobiaoxun.com, tendering entity: CNPC Southwest Oil & Gas Field Co. / Sichuan Chuangang Gas Co., operator Pengzhou Chuangang Gas Co.), the Pengzhou West Line Gas Pipeline runs from '石油彭州输气站（已建）汇管预留41号DN300球阀接管' (a reserved DN300 ball-valve tie-in on the existing CNPC Pengzhou Gas Transmission Station's header) to '插旗村岳家湾德都高速北侧彭州市与都江堰市交界点' (Yuejia Bay, Chaqi Village, on the north side of the Dedu Expressway, at the Pengzhou-Dujiangyan boundary) -- an exact match to GEM's own StartLocation ('CNPC Pengzhou Gas Transmission Station') and EndLocation ('the boundary between Dujiangyan and Pengzhou'). Total length given as 23.76km (GEM's LengthMergedKm is 24.80km -- close, plausibly a route-alignment/rounding difference, not flagged as an error). Pipe is DN250 L245N seamless steel, 4.0MPa design pressure (municipal-grade), 1,000,000 m3/day capacity. Route crosses Shihua Avenue (石化大道), Pengbai Road (彭白路), Jinlong Avenue (金隆大道), Tiangui Road (天桂路), Beigui Road (北桂路), Tuxi River (土溪河, 1x), Tongma River (桐麻河, 5x), a freight railway, a coal conveyor belt, and an asphalt road -- consistent with a route heading roughly west-northwest from the petrochemical-base station area (east Pengzhou, near Tianpeng Subdistrict) to the Dujiangyan boundary (west Pengzhou). Construction tender issued June 2024 (winning bidders Chongqing Xukai Construction Group and Sichuan Jiacheng Construction, contract dated 2024-07-11); a separate environmental-assessment database record (eiage.com, not independently fetchable -- WAF/bot-wall) lists approval 成环审（评）〔2024〕45号 dated 2024-07-18 and a completion date of 2025-03-25.
P7687.researcher_notes: Strong corroboration: both GEM's StartLocation and EndLocation are matched almost verbatim by the source's stated route termini, and the source independently confirms the pipeline's status as CNPC-affiliated (operator Pengzhou Chuangang Gas Co., under Sichuan Chuangang Gas Co. and CNPC Southwest Oil & Gas Field). Length is close (23.76km sourced vs GEM's 24.80km) but not exact -- left unflagged as a likely minor route/rounding variance rather than a data defect, since both endpoints and the operator chain match cleanly. GEM's Status ('proposed') is plausibly stale: the tender/construction-award trail (mid-2024) and the eiage.com-listed 2025-03-25 completion date (from an unfetchable/bot-walled source, not independently verified) suggest this pipeline may already be built or under active construction rather than merely proposed -- worth flagging to the researcher assembling the route-creation batch, though not changed here since Status changes are out of scope for this task.
P7687.blockers: Neither endpoint resolved to a station/village-specific point in Nominatim -- both are road-name-level proxies (a stretch of Shihua Avenue near the presumed station, and Chaqi Road near the presumed Chaqi Village terminus), not exact facility/village coordinates. The eiage.com environmental-assessment database page (which would give the most authoritative approval/completion details) could not be fetched -- it returned only WAF/auth-token code, not article content -- so its 2025-03-25 completion date and 46.33-million-yuan investment figure are not independently verified and are not cited as refs.
